answer: In FY2022, Boeing's effective tax rate was -0.6% (an income tax benefit rate), compared to 14.7% in FY2021. This represents a decrease of 15.3 percentage points in the effective tax rate.
rationale: The effective tax rate for Boeing in FY2022 was -0.6% and in FY2021 was 14.7% (both found in Item 8 Note 4 table of the FY2022 10-K). The difference is -15.3 percentage points.
